name: Curvilinear rooms are judged more beautiful
claim: People judged photos of curvilinear interiors as beautiful more often than rectilinear ones, and pleasantness explained most of the beauty ratings.
caveat: Photographs in an fMRI scanner; contour did not change the decision to enter or leave, so do not use curvature as an approach cue.

sources.title: Vartanian et al. 2013, Impact of contour on aesthetic judgments and approach-avoidance decisions in architecture, PNAS 110 Suppl 2
